Cap internal render resolution roughly 640x480 or max 600 wide proportional aspect to keep realtime. On resize resize visible DPR capped 2 canvas and internal raster buffers, fit cube at all mobile aspect ratios using focal scale min(width,height)*0.95, keep cube center. Wireframe draws visible triangle edges including split diagonals over rendered image using proper scaled screen coordinates; optional project moving light marker using visible canvas and label. Animate rotation and light using requestAnimationFrame elapsed dt capped .05, pause freezes simulation but keeps rendering and FPS sampling. FPS actual frame count/time updated each half second. Avoid repeated keydown triggering and ignore editable targets. Include concise comments explaining matrices, culling, per-vertex Lambert, barycentric perspective interpolation and depth.
